Sect: Independent (Bloodline)

Once a true clan led by an Antediluvian who was destroyed and diablerized, the Salubri are now a nearly extinct line of healers and pacifists, hunted by other Kindred — especially the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} — who brand them as soul-eating infernalists. Many develop a third eye, a mark of their mystic insight that most hide from outsiders, and they remain devoted to the pursuit of Golconda and the redemption of vampire souls.

Disciplines: Auspex, Fortitude, Obeah

Advantage: A Salubri receives two bonus Traits that may only be spent to decrease generation (otherwise they are lost).

Disadvantage: A Salubri who takes blood from an unwilling or resisting victim immediately loses one temporary Willpower Trait and must pass a Conscience/Conviction Test (difficulty 3 Traits) or lose Humanity/Path Traits.

Organization: Scattered and few in number since the destruction of their founder; a Salubri childe traditionally diablerizes their own sire as part of the bloodline's unique Embrace.
